title: Around and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：around　|　正文 307 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 around 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Around, in 1983 the observer carried the lens at the dome, and everybody in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: the observer had carried the lens ② around without complaint, and nobody had asked a single question. The observer had come to the observatory two nights earlier, and spoke little of the observatory he had left behind him.

The log for November 1977 puts it plainer. The lens was ③ around, and the assistant who kept it wrote of the lens ④ around in the same line; nothing in the observatory was ever left around for long in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ around, and ⑥ Around came the assistant who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the observatory had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was that the lens be noted ⑦ around at the dome, and that everybody be ⑧ around before the November rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried around.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993 she carried the lens ⑨ around with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Around, she said in 1995, that was the part the observatory never forgot; the log still speaks of it around. She kept the lens in the same dome for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the observatory never forgot how around it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在周围（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the lens around，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在周围（作表语，说明处所或去向：the lens was around）
C. adv. 到处（置于句首：Around, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 到处（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the lens around）
E. adv. 到处（作介词宾语：from around）
F. adv. 到处（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Around came the assistant）
G. adv. 在周围（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be noted around at the dome）
H. adv. 在周围（be around 说明所在或去向：everybody be around before the rains）

answers.why: around 意为“到处”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Around, in 1983 …。
around 意为“在周围”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the lens around。
around 意为“在周围”，此处作表语说明那件小小的镜片的去向或所在：was around。
around 意为“到处”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the lens around。
around 意为“到处”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from around。
around 意为“到处”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Around came the assistant。
around 意为“在周围”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be noted around at the dome。
around 意为“在周围”，be around 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
around 意为“在周围”，1993 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬运那件小小的镜片，副词置于句末。
around 意为“到处”，母亲 1995 年那句话以地点状语开头：Around, …。
